description: Agent Datasets: submit a dataset’s coverage and representativeness claims with its stated population: the claim with the population it is said to represent, each segment with its dimension (such as region or age band), its value and its share of the population, the places it claims to cover, the period it claims and its wording, read for representative, nationally representative, balanced or unbiased; the records per segment with each dimension, value and count; the records per class label; the records per place; the first and last records with any periods that hold no records; and optionally the points a segment may sit from its population share (5 when left out) and the smallest class as a share of the largest (10 percent when left out). The signed report gives every claimed segment with its population share, its records, its share of the dataset, the points it sits off and its status as within, drifting, skewed, missing or unread, the segments the data holds that the claim leaves out, the classes with the smallest as a share of the largest, every claimed place as covered, missing or unread, the time with the claimed period beside the first and last records and the gaps, and counts them, and names a skewed dataset: a claimed segment or place with no records, a segment more than twice the tolerance from its share, records that start after or end before the claimed period, and representative or balance wording the counts contradict; then segments past the tolerance, segments the claim leaves out, class imbalance below the floor, gaps inside the period and population shares that do not add up, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No segment, place or period claimed, no records per segment, an unstated population share, no records per place, no first and last records and a balance claim with no class counts leave coverage unverified. This reads one dataset against its population: the topics an agent’s knowledge covers are wever_knowledge-coverage-check and an evaluation set against the categories an agent must handle is wever_evaluation-dataset-check. Verdict dataset_coverage_skewed, dataset_coverage_partial, dataset_coverage_unverified or dataset_coverage_representative. POST /api/dataset-coverage-check. Reads the dataset records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Datasets reads a dataset’s own records and checks what is claimed about it: its quality claims against its own sample and profile, its current schema against the documented or prior one, its license against the intended use, its synthetic-data disclosure against its provenance, its freshness against its update log, its lineage against its source records, its privacy claims against its contents and handling, and its coverage against the population it is said to represent. Beside it, wever_data-evidence-check inspects one JSON sample field by field and wever_evaluation-dataset-check reads an evaluation set against what an agent must handle, while a dataset check reads a claim made about a dataset against the dataset’s own records; wever_license-evidence-check names the license family a text matches, while the license check reads the terms against one intended use; and wever_privacy-evidence-check reads privacy claims against a policy document, while the privacy check reads the dataset’s contents and handling records. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-datasets-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-datasets/.

population.description: The population the dataset is said to represent.

text.description: Read for wording such as representative, balanced or unbiased.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

min_class_ratio.description: Smallest class as a share of the largest; 10 when left out.

tolerance_points.description: Points a segment may sit from its share; 5 when left out.

name: wever_dataset-coverage-check
title: Dataset coverage check
